workflow: Calibrate current facing and plate placement

order_contract.incoming: Tickets enter from left and show dish plus ingredient requirements
order_contract.progress_evidence: Only mark an ingredient filled when it is actually part of the plate assigned to that ticket; preparation work can be shown separately. Do not count a shared ingredient twice.
order_contract.deadline: Visible countdown per order; deliver matching completed plate before expiry
order_contract.cooperation: Family shares the kitchen; both preparation and final plate status are visible

bonk_proposal.trigger: Repeated meaningful chef collisions, not simply standing nearby
bonk_proposal.meter: Three playful bonk pips; decay while moving without collisions
bonk_proposal.at_limit: Recoverable drop of held item with clear bounce/sound/feedback
bonk_proposal.tuning: Forgiving cooldown between counted bumps; no forced chain drops or permanent order loss from one collision
bonk_proposal.implementation: Deferred until original art phase as requested

art_generation: Owned by 3D Artist; existing authorized credits only; no extracted commercial references uploaded
animation_contract: Idle, locomotion/glide, carry, chop, wash, throw, catch, dash, celebrate; rig status explicit and held-item sockets calibrated
reference_demo: Current fish/rice proof remains temporary native calibration; original art and later mechanics use burgers.
